text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval to install traffic control signals at the intersection of Steeles Avenue East and Reesor Road (east intersection). The traffic control signals will provide enhanced safety for all road users and is justified based on the assessment undertaken.
The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of traffic control signals at Steeles Avenue East and Reesor Road (east intersection).
